answer: Sybil resistance here is a delayed stake unlock, not a one-time signup fee. An agent that wants harvest rights in the orchard must lock a ferrous-tagged bond at the packing house; the bond cannot be withdrawn until peers have attested thirty consecutive days of consistent work. Cheap aliases can still appear at the river delta, but the waiting period keeps the capital frozen long after a disposable identity would have been discarded, so a farm of sockpuppets bleeds deposits instead of collecting rewards.
